annotations.title: Get the expert picks for this round

description: The current TipMaster Classic round: 25 real football matches per game (btm = Bundesliga TipMaster, tmi = TipMaster International), each with the expert cohort’s home/draw/away split and majority pick (expertPick), and the whole crowd’s split beside it. The expert cohort is the top quarter, by career points per match, of this round’s players with at least 100 career Classic matches, a record kept since 1997. Expert picks are published at the Friday 18:00 Europe/Berlin deadline (releaseUtc); before it released is false, expertPick and expert are null and expertSample is 0, while releaseUtc and criteria are already present. Shares need at least 20 players.
